Start: 1333-11-02  
Add 226 days:  
1333 has 30 days left in November (from Nov 2: 29 days left → Nov 30), so 29 days used.  
Remaining: 226 - 29 = 197 days.  

December 1333: 31 days → 197 - 31 = 166 days left.  

1334 is not a leap year (1334 ÷ 4 = 333.5).  
January 1334: 31 → 166 - 31 = 135  
February 1334: 28 → 135 - 28 = 107  
March 1334: 31 → 107 - 31 = 76  
April 1334: 30 → 76 - 30 = 46  
May 1334: 31 → 46 - 31 = 15  
June 1334: 30 → 15 - 30 → not enough, so stop before subtracting all of June.  

Thus, after May 31, 1334, we have 15 days left → add to June 1: June 15, 1334.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1334-06-15
